articles.summary: For brand CX and 3PL ops teams. A customer reported an $800 order never received, 75 hours after it was delivered, signed for, and photographed. The building's own log showed a friend collected it five minutes after dropoff. What to check — and in what order — when tracking says delivered and the customer says no.
articles.title: Your Customer Says "Never Received." Tracking Says Delivered.

articles.summary: Built for Shopify requires a carrier-rate endpoint to answer in under 500 ms at the 95th percentile. Ours failed, then passed some days, then passed every day. Here is what we changed at each stage, what each stage cost us, and the numbers.
articles.title: How We Got Our Shopify Carrier Rates Under 500 ms
